description: Calculate a SKU's reorder point, stock coverage and indicative replenishment quantity using daily demand, lead time, safety stock and committed units. The model assumes constant demand and lead time. It does not optimize purchase minimums, case multiples, campaigns, expiry, financing or supplier variability. With zero demand, coverage days are undefined. Confirmed inbound can improve position without preventing a stockout before arrival: check its timing. Input fields: dailyDemand: Your projection, excluding orders already counted as reserved. leadDays: From purchase placement to usable stock. reviewDays: Additional horizon used to calculate the replenishment target. safetyUnits: Your chosen buffer; no statistical service level is inferred. onHandUnits: Include your safety buffer; exclude damaged or unusable goods. reservedUnits: Unshipped commitments. They may exceed physical stock. incomingUnits: Only units usable within the lead time. A delay changes the scenario.
name: calculate_reorder_point
title: Reorder point and inventory replenishment calculator
